name: hardware
title: Hardware95 foundation
description: The base of every Hardware95 part: shared material, legend, accent, bevel and shadow tokens, a matte plastic Faceplate in putty, cream or khaki, printed Legend text and a glass pilot Lamp.
docs: Hardware95 parts style themselves under [data-hw] and never touch your shadcn theme, so they drop into any app. Faceplate takes finish="putty" | "cream" | "khaki" and draws corner screws unless screws={false}. Legend prints condensed caps onto the panel in size sm, md or lg. Lamp takes on and tone="red" | "amber" | "green". Every color and depth recipe is a --hw-* custom property, so override one on any ancestor to restyle every part inside it.
